## 9 v2 side-by-side (NOT like-for-like)

| | v2 live simulation (meta + temporal correlator) | v3 M2 K | v3 M2 C |
|---|---|---|---|
| false alarms | 1.9% of normal rows (fusion only 1.8%) | 2.1% of clean ticks, 25.40 events/h | 6.7% of clean ticks, 30.96 events/h |
| detection | recall 84.2% of attack rows | tick recall 26.0%, composite event det 60.2% | tick recall 64.2%, event det 96.0% |
| first-alert delay | {"02 GPS spoofing": 0, "04 CAN DoS": 0, "06 Network DoS": 0, "08 LiDAR phantom object": 38, "10 CAN DoS + GPS spoofing": 0, "12 Stealthy: CAN RPM spoof + LiDAR blind spot": 0} rows | per family (section 5) | per family (section 5) |

Why not like-for-like: v2 = 7,800 rows in 12 long blocks from the four domains' test sets with a SUPERVISED meta-classifier trained on the same attack classes, random halves, a correlator that escalates threat levels (no events, no clean-hour rate) and a LiDAR phantom proxy; v3 = 1 Hz composite drives over five domains + cross-domain, label-free combiner, group-aware LOGO thresholds, held-out (zero-day) types, events per clean hour.
